title: Smokehouse: Playlet Replayer & Telemetry Harness for Safe Incident Reproduction
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Build a lightweight 'Smokehouse' service that can ingest recorded playlets (sanitized incident traces + ordered admin steps) and execute them in a sandboxed, time-shifted environment. Purpose: enable on-call and SREs to reproduce complex support scenarios reliably, validate runbook changes as tasks, and collect deterministic telemetry for post-incident analysis without touching production state. This ticket covers the MVP plumbing: ingestion format, sandbox runtime, telemetry capture hooks, RBAC for execution, and quick integration points for the existing runbook-as-tasks runner.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest playlet packages (manifest + step list + trace blobs) via the Smokehouse API and persist to the replay store (S3 prefix) with ACLs
Execute a playlet in 'dry-run' mode against a shadowed runtime (no external side effects) and produce a trace that correlates to input events
Captured telemetry includes request/response pairs, KV-cache snapshots, model selection decisions, and kernel scheduling annotations for each step
Sanitization pipeline strips PII and secrets using the redact-config from the security team before storage
Hook for runbooks-as-tasks: a Smokehouse run can emit a Linear-compatible result artifact link that is automatically attached to the originating runbook ticket
RBAC: only users in group 'ops-replay' or members with 'replay_execute' permission can start a run; execution audit logs are stored for 90 days
E2E smoke test: reproduce 3 historical incidents (IDs linked below) deterministically within 60s of runtime and with telemetry matching saved golden traces
tasks: Define playlet schema (manifest, steps, trace references, metadata) - RFC in docs
Implement ingestion API (+ validation + sanitization hook)
Build sandbox runtime harness that forks a lightweight 'shadow' inference runtime with config overrides
Integrate telemetry hooks into serving runtime to export condensed artifacts (KV snapshot, kernel metrics)
Implement dry-run semantics and 'timewarp' mode to replay event timestamps
Add RBAC checks and audit log entries to admin console
Add CLI for devs to create and submit playlets from local dev environments
Create E2E tests and import three historical incidents as golden data
